title: kit.approval-ledger.v1
description: The one approval ledger of the kit (docs/CONCEPTS.md section 5, docs/PERSIAN.md section 6): the append-only, hash-chained, signed record of human sign-offs used for the Shariah concept series (subject id) and for Persian native review, fa-review.json (subject file). The ledger's id, project and kind come from the kit project registry, never from the project's own config, and are inside every signed body, so a signature made for one ledger is worthless in another. Entries are never rewritten or re-sorted: each carries `seq`, the sha256 `prev` of the entry before it (the first: the genesis of the git commit the chain is anchored at), a UTC timestamp inside the signed body (not in the future) and, unless it is a baseline, an Ed25519 signature by the approver's own key. Roster changes are roster-add / roster-remove entries that take effect when a strict majority of the current roster has signed the same one (a one-member roster changes only through the owner-signed trust record), and roster-rotate entries (a member replaces their own key, signed with the old one; earlier entries stay verifiable). A withdrawal by any member holds a subject until the same member or a strict majority of the roster lifts it. Verified by kit check (shariah-review, fa-review, canon) and, from the public keys alone, by the run time. Written by kit shariah / kit persian and the signing page, never by hand.

kind.description: shariah, persian (approval kinds: approved, rejected, withdrawn) or uploads (upload decisions: release, hold, unhold, rescan, delete). Each kind declares its actions; the verifier and checkAppend refuse an action the kind does not have, and one the owner-signed record does not grant the member.

subject.description: What an entry approves: a concept id (shariah) or a source file (persian).

commit.description: The git commit the chain starts from; it must be an ancestor of HEAD (the check uses merge-base --is-ancestor) and, once registered, the registry's anchor.

genesis.description: sha256 of "kit.approval-ledger.v1:anchor:<commit>": the `prev` of the first entry.

baselineThrough.description: How many leading entries may be unsigned baselines (copy live before the gate). Recorded once, when the ledger is created.

migratedFrom.description: Set by kit persian migrate: the sha256 of the old-format ledger file this one replaced and how many entries it carried. The history check and the verifier accept the format change only when the owner-signed trust record names exactly this migration (once, persian ledgers only).

sha256.description: The content hash the approver read (concepts: the reviewed fields; persian: the Persian segments of the file).

by.description: A name of the roster; required unless a baseline.

at.description: UTC, ending in Z, inside the signed body; refused when more than five minutes in the future.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature, the one canonical base64 spelling of 64 bytes, over the signed body (see @saasreport/core/ledger).

segments.description: Persian: how many Persian segments the hash covers.

actions.description: roster-add: the actions the new member may sign, limited to what its signers hold.

expires.description: roster-add / roster-remove only: when this proposal lapses (at most 14 days after `at`). A proposal takes effect only when a majority has signed it before then; a stale one can never be completed later.

project.description: A key of the kit project registry (packages/core/registry/projects.json).
